entities.summary: Victor Amadeus of Anhalt-Bernburg-Schaumburg-Hoym, was a German prince of the House of Ascania from the Anhalt-Bernburg branch through the sub-branch of Anhalt-Bernburg-Schaumburg-Hoym and a Russian General under the service of Empress Catherine II the Great.
